name: Pennywise in Sewer
look: Top: Tim Curry as Pennywise, a white-faced clown with a red nose and red hair, grins from inside a storm drain at a child in a yellow raincoat at the right edge. Below, three small photos show a person in blue shorts squeezing into a curb drain until only a foot is left.
use: Pennywise offers something tempting from the sewer, and the strip below shows someone eagerly crawling in anyway, mocking how easily people fall for an obvious trap.
slots: the tempting offer (top, Pennywise in the drain)
examples: Want to start a new hobby instead of finishing the old one?
describe: clown in the storm drain and someone crawling into the sewer
creepy clown peeking out of a gutter then a person jumps in
kid squeezing into a storm drain after the clown lures them
tim curry clown in the sewer grate with someone crawling in
person diving head first into a curb drain
origin: The top still is Tim Curry as Pennywise talking to Georgie through a storm drain in the 1990 TV miniseries It.
